benefits.text:
hince Second Skin Mesh Matte Cushion is a vegan matte cushion with a thin, lightweight mesh texture that helps create a soft, smooth, natural and breathable base. It provides good coverage while keeping a light feel on the face, and helps even out skin tone, cover imperfections naturally and create a clean soft matte effect. The base adheres well, helps limit darkening and keeps a smooth finish for many hours, suited to everyday makeup and to combination or oily-leaning skin that needs a matte base without feeling heavy or stuffy.
1. Thin, lightweight mesh texture that is easy to pat on and blends easily into the skin.
2. Soft matte finish helps the skin's surface look smoother, cleaner and more natural.
3. Soft matte cushion formula that helps the base last longer and helps limit a dry feeling on the skin.

Second Skin Mesh Matte Cushion, also known by its #BlueCushion image, is one of hince's standout cushion lines, with many achievements recorded in brand materials. The line has sold more than 1.38 million units and is a winner of the Olive Young Awards for 2 consecutive years and the Glowpick Awards for 4 consecutive years. These achievements help reinforce Second Skin Mesh Matte Cushion's position as hince's key matte cushion, loved for its thin, lightweight base, soft pore-blurring effect and suitability for combination skin's need for a clean, long-wearing, natural base.

The 2026 Chill Voyage Limited Edition features a watery blue summer design, keeping the spirit of #PoreBlurCushion and #BlueCushion while adding a more finely tuned shade range for a variety of skin undertones. The limited edition includes shades 13 Pure, 15 Rosy, 17 Porcelain, 19 Cream, 21 Ivory and 23 Sand; of these, 13 Pure and 19 Cream are 2 new neutral shades developed after a color adjustment process to help users choose a base more easily when their current shade is too dark, too light or too pink. This edition suits customers who want a thin, lightweight matte cushion that blurs pores, with limited-edition packaging and a shade range that blends more easily for summer makeup.

safety.text:
For external use only; do not use on damaged skin
Discontinue use if signs of irritation appear, and keep out of reach of children.

claimDisclaimers.text: The limited-edition PDF states 11g, SPF40 PA++, Vegan & Mild and Triple-Functional Cosmetic; do not reuse the regular edition's 12g weight for this edition. The No.1/awards/sales claims follow brand materials and the data stated in the PDF; do not interpret them as No.1 in the Vietnamese market without local data.
